Scrap is used to upgrade units. There are two methods of earning Scrap points in the game.

Scrap points are earned through scrapping units in the [http://cryhavoc.wikia.com/wiki/Squad_Bay Squad Bay] or by winning battles. The amount of Scrap gained from scrapping units depends on what Tier and/or level the unit you are going to scrap (e.g. scrapping a T1 H4 Helo will yield 2 Scrap points while scrapping a T2 Scorpion will yield 10 Scrap points).

An arrow will appear next to a unit indicating that it can be upgraded once you gain enough Scrap points.
